source_release_synovitis_author_manifest.basis: Previously saved author aggregate manifest; source rows outside prepared weak were not included in study-level calculations.

interpretation: The source itself has49 observed Synovitis negatives, all N and no B. Prepared weak retains all49, so negative scarcity predates splitting.
Fold0 further concentrates the scarcity: validation100 positive/1 negative; training422 positive/48 negative. Five validation-fold negative counts are1,25,7,10,6.
Fold0 Synovitis observed-positive rate100/101 makes AUC strongly dependent on one negative rank; it is not a stable standalone image-discrimination estimate.
U/M stays missing. Replacing it with0 or forcing prevalence toward expert labels changes supervision and is not justified by these counts.
N and B are distinct extraction states even though both train as0. Preserve them in training-side report-only audits of explicit denial versus threshold interpretation.
State consistency/model agreement does not prove clinical image-label correctness, patient independence, competition eligibility or absence of unseen development exposure.
Keep the current split for initial controlled model comparisons. If grouping-preserving observed-positive/negative balancing is introduced later, create a new split version and rerun its baseline.
computation: Python standard-library csv/Counter with assertions; P=1,N/B=0,U/M=missing; no threshold fitting or statistical independence claim.
